brief.en: Snips zombies, than charges down lane
brief.zh: 夹击僵尸，被啃咬时冲出并攻击前方所有僵尸

description.en: Parsnips snip at zombies, then charge down the lane at the last moment.
description.zh: 防风草掐伤身前的僵尸，被啃咬后冲出夹击本行前方的僵尸

chat.en: "Snip!" said Parsnip. "Snip snip snip! If it wasn't for my scrapbook, my coupons, and snipping zombies to death, I just don't know what I'd do with myself!"
chat.zh: “我掐！”防风草叫道。“我掐我掐我掐！要不是为了制作我的剪贴簿、抢我的优惠券，还有掐死僵尸，我都不知道拿自己怎么办！”

text.en: charges down the lane when defeated and snips zombies in front
text.zh: 被啃食完毕后沿着本行冲出，掐前方的僵尸
